purpose: Correct the v0 union-of-gold-and-evidence confound before selecting a new runtime mechanism from the frozen 175-question development profile.
problem: The v0 funnel counted any gold or supporting-evidence arrival as reference arrival. That permits supporting-only retrieval to look like a gold-document exposure failure, so its 47/67 hidden-answer route cannot select a runtime mechanism.
simplest_baseline: Read only the frozen v10 runs, development gold docids, failure profile, and calibrated Judge labels. Recompute arrival and literal answer coverage separately for gold documents, supporting-evidence documents, their union, and the final bracket-cited documents.
hypothesis: The corrected distribution will preserve separate retrieval/evidence-frontier, gold-span-exposure, evidence-selection, synthesis-verification, and answer-contract queues without asserting that any queue is ready for a runtime intervention.
claim_boundary: This selected-after-v0, gold-aware posthoc development localization diagnostic does not reopen the registered 47/67 v0 result or set a promotion threshold. Literal answer coverage and bracketed citation association are trace proxies, not causal effectiveness metrics. It makes no provider, online-search, Judge, GPU, or sealed-holdout call and cannot establish harness gain, official accuracy, leaderboard standing, framework superiority, or model-capability improvement. Any runtime mechanism must be separately preregistered on a fresh development slice with fixed model, corpus, search provider, tool budget, Token budget, cost budget, and Judge.
